summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, announcing a directors' circular urging shareholders to reject Curaleaf Holdings' hostile tender offer. Aurora's board, on the unanimous recommendation of a special committee of independent directors and after external financial and legal advice, deemed the bid inadequate and undervaluing. Aurora emphasizes its debt-free status with $149 million cash versus Curaleaf's over $1 billion debt. The board recommends shareholders take no action, not tender, and withdraw any tendered shares. Risk-arb watch: Curaleaf may raise its bid or wage a proxy fight; Aurora's defense includes highlighting balance-sheet disparity and limited upside.
